# References

## Photo patch placement / jigsaw reasoning

- Noroozi, M. and Favaro, P. (2016). “Unsupervised Learning of Visual Representations by Solving Jigsaw Puzzles.” *European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV)*. DOI: [10.1007/978-3-319-46466-4_5](https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-319-46466-4_5). This is a published example of inferring spatial relationships between shuffled image patches.
- Doersch, C., Gupta, A., and Efros, A. A. (2015). “Unsupervised Visual Representation Learning by Context Prediction.” *IEEE International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)*. DOI: [10.1109/ICCV.2015.167](https://doi.org/10.1109/ICCV.2015.167). This paper uses relative patch context as a visual reasoning signal.
